title: One Context Across All Your Agents | Make0
excerpt: Make0 Brain syncs all your agents with common context and connects via MCP to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and any AI app.
content_html:
AI memory that follows you across apps

Make0 gives you a personal AI Brain: persistent, portable memory for your context, knowledge, and preferences across ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, the Make0 Agent, and MCP-compatible AI apps.

Import what your AI already knows, review and edit every memory, and use the same context wherever you work.
